workflow_role: Primary chemistry input for reconstructing burned-reference contrasts and annual lnRR
known_transformations: Per-study files combined; units harmonized; duplicate site-date observations averaged; daily time series gap-filled and interpolated; Abbott et al. 2021 excluded
manual_corrections_or_caveats: Interpolation creates temporal dependence and can inflate apparent sample size; observed-versus-interpolated provenance must be retained or reconstructed for sensitivity analysis

workflow_role: Primary site-level watershed climate hydrology soil land-cover and fire predictor input
known_transformations: Coordinates linked to NHD COMIDs; StreamCat NHD and fire attributes extracted at site level
manual_corrections_or_caveats: Gaviota COMID manually set to 17594763; non-CONUS sites and sites without valid COMIDs have missing attributes; burn severity coverage is incomplete

workflow_role: Study site fire design citation and provenance reference used to audit identifiers and pairing decisions
known_transformations: Compiled from included publications and project metadata
manual_corrections_or_caveats: Study fire comparison and pair identifiers must be reconciled with the chemistry table before modeling; author review is required for ambiguous or shared-control pairings

workflow_role: Benchmark for checking regenerated annual effect sizes; not an authoritative modeling input
known_transformations: Daily burned-reference lnRR values averaged by calendar year; daily variance divided by daily count; includes non-normalized and area-normalized metrics
manual_corrections_or_caveats: Current pairing uses every burned-by-unburned combination within a Comparison_ID; shared controls induce covariance; interpolation and serial dependence are not reflected in the variance; area-normalized fields are excluded from the new primary analysis
